newsitem.title: SWEDEN: Swedish Riksbank drains 13 bln SKR from the market.
newsitem.headline: Swedish Riksbank drains 13 bln SKR from the market.

text.p: Sweden's central bank, the Riksbank, said on Tuesday it drained 13 billion crowns from the market in its weekly reverse repurchase operation.
The reverse repo was set at an unchanged fixed rate of 4.10 percent and will run from February 19 to February 26, replacing an operation that drained 13.5 billion crowns from the market.
The Riksbank said 3.15 percent of the bids for the tender were allocated. -- Stockholm newsroom +46-8-700 1006 '
